hits.name: Andres Vandal
hits.text:
Así como ALF la blancanieves, vuelve en forma de fichas, la verdad cuando decimos que ella es la depredadora más grande del bosque creo que nos quedamos cortos 

Gracias a nuestros amigos de @WhatsTokenAI por hacer posible estos videos, ya saben que están implementando cosas
hits.original_en:
Just like ALF, Snow White is back, this time in the form of game pieces. Honestly, when we say she is the biggest predator in the forest, I think we are selling her short.

Thanks to our friends at @WhatsTokenAI for making these videos possible. You know they are rolling things out.
hits.hook: A 75-second dark take on Snow White as the forest's top predator, captioned in Spanish, did 246K views, 4.1K likes and 2.1K bookmarks.
hits.video_tip: Take one famous fairy-tale character and flip them into the villain: 60-75s, open on the most unsettling close-up, no title card, and keep the caption to one wry line that sells the twist.
hits.draft_en:
Snow White just came back as game pieces, the same way ALF did.

We keep calling her the biggest predator in the forest, and honestly that might be too gentle.

This AI Video only exists thanks to @WhatsTokenAI, and they keep shipping new stuff. Dark fairy-tale animation is my favorite corner of AI filmmaking right now.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.

trend_radar.legend: Trend match 0-100% = 1 - prod(1 - w) over matched 24 h keywords that another author also used in the 48 h window (w: rank 1-10 0.35, 11-25 0.22, 26-40 0.12, curated 0.20). Verdict: >= 50% -> trend; else video/image in the post data -> visual; else >= 100K followers (outsiders without follower data: >= 500K views, estimate) -> author/audience; else coincidence/other. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h. Trend-input-only accounts feed the corpus but are never shown as hits.
